step_up.strategy: only when normal horizontal test_move is blocked; near-to-far downward rays resolve the nearest valid tread independent of legacy winding; sub-epsilon surface noise is ignored; vertical lift and a minimum collision-tested forward settle must both pass before the body advances; floor snap resolves the resulting tread contact
step_up.probe_strategy: near-to-far multi-probe; choose smallest valid positive rise above step_surface_epsilon
step_up.probe_distances: dynamic motion+1, motion+4, motion+8, then configured max probe
step_up.backface_policy: explicit hit_back_faces=true; horizontal tread acceptance uses abs(normal.y) because legacy winding is not semantic
step_up.runtime_diagnostics: bounded step_debug trace with probe hit/miss, face index, normal, height, rejection reason and success
